name: video-editor-policy
note: Video-editor default policy. video.* read/edit/render/transcribe are automatic inside the project workspace (reversible-write, snapshot/rollback). video.export / video.publish still need user confirmation every time (external side effect) even though listed true — the broker's action class requires it. video.delete is listed true but risk=critical, so it needs explicit confirmation + step-up auth. Network is offline: editing is local; model downloads for faster-whisper need a network state change first.
